About

Who is DJ Prackz

DJ Prackz plays techno, hip hop, commercial, Bollywood, Punjabi and house mixes, and moves between them as the room changes.

With 200+ events behind the decks and sets in multiple languages, every night is built around the people on the floor. Follow @dj_prackz on Instagram for clips and new dates.
